story.title: Training Dogs for Real Life at Home
story.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Yakir Lavi, and for over a decade my main work has been helping families live better with their dogs. I train companion and house dogs in basic obedience, leash manners, impulse control, and solving everyday behavior problems — always through clear structure and classical methods.
story.paragraph2: My professional path began with dedicated training in companion dogs: understanding dog psychology, correcting behavior issues, and building reliable obedience for life at home. That foundation is what most of my clients benefit from today.
story.paragraph3: Over 10 years, I've trained more than 500 dogs — puppies learning their first rules, adolescent dogs with too much energy, and adult dogs with behavior challenges. I believe every family deserves a dog they can trust and enjoy in daily life.
story.paragraph4: Alongside this work, I developed deep expertise in IGP sport — a demanding discipline combining tracking, precision obedience, and protection. That advanced path is available for handlers who want to compete, and you can read more about it in the dedicated section below.
story.quote: My mission is to help you build a calm, confident, and well-mannered dog at home. Clear rules, consistent training, and understanding how your dog thinks — that's what creates lasting change.

experience.title: International Training & Seminars
experience.subtitle: Continuing education — from companion dogs to working dogs and IGP protection

items.title: Companion & House Dog Training
items.description: Before my international training in the Czech Republic, I completed professional education focused on companion dogs: solving behavioral problems, the theory and psychology of dogs, and foundational obedience training. This built the base for everything that followed — understanding how dogs think, learn, and live alongside their families.

items.title: Working Dog Immersion Program
items.description: In 2017, I spent a full month in the Czech Republic in an intensive program dedicated to working dogs. It was a deep immersion in understanding this type of dog — how to raise, train, and work with them from puppyhood through maturity — and it strengthened the professional foundation I still draw on every day.

items.title: IGP Protection — The Helper's Perspective
items.description: In July 2026, I completed a helper seminar focused on IGP protection work from the helper's side. I expanded my knowledge of how to build strong, controlled protection phases with dogs, proper sleeve presentation and grip techniques, and a range of training approaches used in professional protection work.
